text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Today's chores are... Harvesting the 
fields, organizing documents, and helping 
with shopping, huh~."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ow-ow-ow~... My head's really hurting a 
lot today.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Still, I can't just leave early... 
Everyone's counting on me, after all!

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Man A
text_block_list.text:
Listen up, Kita-chan! Resting is important 
when you're sick, but above all, you need 
an undaunted spirit!

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Man A
text_block_list.text:
No matter how tough things get, as long as 
you've got powerful vocal trills, surely—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Kitasan Black had carelessly made 
her headache even worse.
